title: Model tier breakdown collage and quickstart screenshot set for release notes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a set of onboarding/quickstart visuals and product screenshots for the upcoming model catalog release notes. Deliverables should include: a hero collage that communicates model tiers (Free, Starter, Pro, Dedicated), compact and expanded model-card screenshots, pricing-callout overlays, deprecation badge states (sunset date + migration link), and annotated hotspots for the quickstart guide. Export specs: PNG @2x (1600px wide for hero), SVG icons for badges, and single-frame JPEGs for release notes. Include localized variants for en-US, fr-FR, de-DE, es-ES, ja-JP, ko-KR, pt-BR, and zh-CN. Ensure alt-text copy is provided for all images and that color contrast meets AA standards. Coordinate with PM and engineering for accuracy on throughput/latency callouts and to include a compact per-route cost snapshot sample.
acceptance_criteria: Hero collage exported in PNG @2x and layered Figma file provided
Model-card screenshots: compact (300x220) and expanded detail (740x340) exported for each tier
Pricing overlay artwork shows per-token baseline, throughput band, and recommended quantization level callout
Deprecation badge states: Active, Deprecated (with date), Sunset (locked) — each has copy and link placeholder
Localized image sets provided for 8 locales with translated callouts and verified line breaks
Figma file includes named frames and an export checklist; handoff ticket posted to engineering and PM
Alt text and A11y notes included in the export manifest
